create.name: Finnbarr Kennedy
create.bio:
Finnbarr Kennedy lived for twenty-one years as a monk of the Thai Forest lineage of Theravada Buddhism, training under the meditation master Luangpu Sangwan Khemako of Wat Thung Samakkhi Tham; his monastic name was Bhikkhu Dhammasaro. After leaving monastic life he settled as a hermit among the vineyards of western Hungary, not far from Lake Balaton, where he looks after the small Brightheart Meditation Center. Retreatants lodge in guesthouses nearby, or pitch a tent on the land, and come together to sit in a yurt meditation hall, with walks through the vines and the neighbouring woods as part of the day.

His teaching rests on mindfulness and metta, the practice of loving-kindness, which he offers as a way to clear and open the heart. He leads live guided sittings on YouTube three times a day on Central European Time and shares recorded meditations and readings of his verse on Insight Timer. He is the author of The Timeless Heart, a book of forty-four illustrated contemplative poems. All of his guidance is given on a donation basis, and he lives on what students choose to offer.

courses.title: Meditation retreats at Brightheart Meditation Center
courses.description: Stay for a personal retreat at Finnbarr's simple centre in the Hungarian vineyards, sitting with him in a yurt meditation hall. Guests book their own room in a local guesthouse or camp on the land, and the meditation guidance itself is given for a donation.

courses.title: Finnbarr Kennedy on Patreon
courses.description: A membership on Patreon through which students support Finnbarr's teaching and receive his members-only guided meditations. Tier prices are set on Patreon.

free_resources.title: Finnbarr Kennedy on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Recorded metta and heart-centred guided sittings, plus short readings from his book of contemplative verse. Free to play in the app or a web browser.

free_resources.title: Daily online meditation with Finnbarr
free_resources.description: Finnbarr leads three live guided sittings each day on the Brightheart Meditation Center YouTube channel, in the morning, afternoon and evening on Central European Time. Anyone can join, and donations are welcome but not required.
